contact.full_name: Business Analyst | Capital Markets | Regulatory Reporting | Trade Lifecycle | UAT

data.summary: Business Analyst with 8+ years of experience across capital markets, regulatory reporting, trade lifecycle operations, and banking. Strong background in OTC derivatives, front-to-back trade flow, UAT, reconciliations, regulatory controls, and stakeholder management. Experienced in translating business and regulatory requirements into BRD/FRD, test scenarios, process documentation, governance reporting, and change initiatives. Working knowledge of EMIR, MiFID II, SFTR, HKMA, MAS, and ASIC reporting requirements, with exposure to Market Risk, Credit Risk, and Counterparty Risk. Skilled in Jira, Tableau, Power BI, QlikView, Excel, and cross-functional delivery across business, operations, compliance, and technology teams. Backed by a Post-Graduation Certification in Business Analytics and Project Management from IIT Roorkee.

raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Business Analyst with 8+ years of experience across capital markets, regulatory reporting, trade lifecycle operations, and banking. Strong background in OTC derivatives, front-to-back trade flow, UAT, reconciliations, regulatory controls, and stakeholder management. Experienced in translating business and regulatory requirements into BRD/FRD, test scenarios, process documentation, governance reporting, and change initiatives. Working knowledge of EMIR, MiFID II, SFTR, HKMA, MAS, and ASIC reporting requirements, with exposure to Market Risk, Credit Risk, and Counterparty Risk. Skilled in Jira, Tableau, Power BI, QlikView, Excel, and cross-functional delivery across business, operations, compliance, and technology teams. Backed by a Post-Graduation Certification in Business Analytics and Project Management from IIT Roorkee.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE SKILLS
Business Analysis
Requirements Gathering, Gap Analysis, BRD, FRD, Process Mapping, SOP Documentation, Stakeholder Management, Workshop Facilitation, Change Management, Project Coordination
Capital Markets & Trade Lifecycle
OTC Derivatives, Trade Lifecycle, Front-to-Back Operations, Regulatory Reporting, Trade Reconciliation, Lifecycle Events, UTI/UPI Validation, Counterparty Classification, Valuation Review
Testing & Controls
UAT, Test Scenario Design, Defect Tracking, Reconciliation, Root Cause Analysis, Control Validation, Audit Readiness, Exception Management
Risk & Regulatory
EMIR, MiFID II, SFTR, HKMA, MAS, ASIC, Regulatory Controls, Market Risk, Credit Risk, Counterparty Risk, Governance Reporting
Tools
Jira, Tableau, Power BI, QlikView, Murex, DTCC, Qomply, UnaVista, ULLINK, Intellimatch, eRecon, Finacle, Excel, PowerPoint
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Business Analyst | First Rand Services Pvt.Ltd
Mumbai | 03/2024 - 02/2025
Company providing financial services focusing on data analytics and process improvement
Served as a techno-functional Business Analyst and SME for OTC derivatives regulatory reporting UAT, supporting compliance across EMIR, MiFID II, and SFTR.
Led client and stakeholder workshops to gather business, functional, and regulatory requirements and convert them into BRD, FRD, and test-ready documentation.
Performed control gap analysis and validated Controls 6 & 8, 11, and 15, improving reporting readiness and control compliance.
Validated key reporting attributes including UTI/UPI logic, counterparty classification, valuation methodology, and lifecycle events across reporting workflows.
Executed UAT, reconciliations, and defect validation using Intellimatch, DTCC, Murex, UnaVista, ULLINK, and Qomply.
Supported process redesign and automation initiatives that reduced manual reconciliation effort across reporting regimes.
Strengthened operational and audit readiness through SOP validation, user training, and post-implementation support.
Prepared executive dashboards and management presentations to simplify complex regulatory and reconciliation data for senior stakeholders.
Contributed to Qomply implementation to enhance cross-regime reconciliation and reporting accuracy.
Associate Process Manager | Eclerx Services Pvt Ltd
Mumbai, MH | 08/2021 - 01/2024
Business process management service provider
Acted as a functional SME and BA liaison for regulatory reporting processes covering HKMA, MAS, and ASIC.
Performed end-to-end analysis of reporting breaks, driving root cause identification and remediation aligned with regulatory control requirements.
Managed client reporting issues and escalations from initial investigation through resolution, providing timely updates and coordinating corrective actions with internal stakeholders.
Facilitated process walkthroughs, control assessments, and stakeholder discussions to identify operational risks and improvement opportunities.
Conducted reconciliations and exception analysis across front-office, middle-office, and trade repository data sets.
Acted as a client-facing point of contact for regulatory reporting enquiries and service requests, understanding client requirements and coordinating with internal teams to provide timely resolution
Produced weekly, fortnightly, and monthly governance packs highlighting over-reporting, under-reporting, and exception trends.
Led cross-functional efforts to redesign workflows, improving turnaround time, control effectiveness, and audit outcomes.
Managed a team of 15 members supporting regulatory reporting activities, overseeing daily work allocation, workflow management, quality, productivity and timely delivery.
• Created SOPs, training decks, and knowledge documents to support process stabilization and change management initiatives.
Mandar Pawar
• Worked directly with clients and stakeholders to clarify regulatory reporting requirements, data discrepancies and reporting
exceptions, ensuring follow-up and closure within agreed timelines
Analyst | Citicorp Financial Services Pvt Ltd
Mumbai, MH | 11/2018 - 10/2020
Global financial services company
Prepared and reviewed balance sheet reconciliations for multiple legal entities across EMEA, ensuring adherence to internal financial controls.
Investigated complex reconciling items and supported audit, governance, and control reporting.
Reported reconciliation status through eRecon, improving transparency, tracking, and data integrity.
Partnered with stakeholders to improve data quality, reconciliation accuracy, and reporting consistency.
Officer | Axis Bank Pvt Ltd
Mumbai | 02/2017 - 01/2018
Private sector bank
Managed IPO and ASBA operations in line with banking policies and regulatory guidelines.
Performed daily reconciliations and prepared fortnightly certification reports to support control and reporting requirements.
Resolved customer escalations within defined service timelines while maintaining service quality.
Generated MIS reports and processed RTGS and NEFT transactions using Finacle.
Auditor – Internship | R.Shah & Associates
Mumbai, MH | 04/2016 - 02/2017
Auditing and consulting firm
Conducted internal and external audits covering inventory, cash transactions, and discount structures.
Prepared audit documentation and supported statutory compliance reporting.
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS
Improved workflow efficiency by 30% through process streamlining and stronger cross-functional coordination.
Helped drive 95% reporting accuracy across multi-jurisdiction regulatory reporting activities.
Increased team productivity by 25% through process improvements and collaborative workshops.
Developed training materials that improved staff competency by 40%, contributing to fewer process errors.
Executive MBA, Finance | Wellingkar Institute | Mumbai, Maharashtra | 2019 - 2020
Bachelor of Commerce | Tilak College | Mumbai, Maharashtra | 2013 - 2016
Mandar Pawar
Mandar Pawar
